reconstruction_notes.en: Original lofts vary lobe size, elongation, neck width and curvature before soft union. Restrained skin channels converge around inflated ends; bounded flat cut is a teaching presentation choice. Colors, nominal dimensions and simplified layout are artistic. Shape alone is not a field diagnosis proving submarine origin; no exact site or date reconstruction.
